title: Wrong Outfit, Wrong Paddle
desc: A fun-themed open play where players come dressed in mismatched outfits and bring their “wrong” paddle, followed by competitive DUPR-rated games.

title: 2nd Team Tournament
desc: CCPC’s second team-based tournament, bringing players together to compete, build chemistry, and battle for the championship.

title: Drills
desc: A focused training session designed to improve fundamentals, technique, consistency, and game strategy through structured drills.

title: One Mindoro: Dual Meet
desc: A friendly but competitive dual meet bringing together pickleball players from Oriental Mindoro and Occidental Mindoro in the spirit of sportsmanship and camaraderie.

title: DUPR Open Play
desc: Competitive open play sessions where games are recorded for DUPR ratings, giving players an opportunity to test their skills and track their progress.

title: CCPC Week
desc: A week-long celebration of the Calapan City Pickleball Club featuring games, activities, community events, and opportunities for members to connect and play.

title: Christmas Party
desc: A festive celebration bringing the CCPC community together for good food, fun games, laughter, and a year-end celebration of friendship, sportsmanship, and memorable moments on and off the court.

title: CCPC x MTC Dual Meet
desc: An exhibition match against the Morning Tickle Club.
